faq.question: Is skateboard allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Skateboard is restricted in carry-on luggage. TSA allows skateboards in carry-on and checked luggage. However, airlines regulate carry-on size/weight, and some airlines require skateboards to be checked.

faq.question: Can you pack skateboard in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Skateboard is allowed in checked bags.
